---
title: "Initial Uptake Rate"
author: "Arielle Smith with Claude assistance"
date: "2026-11-06"
output: html_document
---

This is a script to calculate the proportion of 13-17 NEDA screen respondents who 
screen At-Risk for or with a Likely ED who clicked the link to try PBN on Koko. 
To match the data pull dates received, restricting analysis to responses received through 10/28/26. 
Of note, National Eating Disorders Screening Day was held on October 14, so this may be a
potential confounding variable, but this is the data available at the moment (need some data before grant deadline). 

```{r}
if(!require(dplyr)){install.packages('dplyr')}
library(dplyr)
if(!require(lubridate)){install.packages('lubridate')}
library(lubridate) 

neda_data <- read.csv("Data/neda_screen/neda_data.csv")
koko_data <- read.csv("Data/neda_screen/koko_data.csv")
```

```{r filter NEDA data to end at 10/28/26}
neda_filtered <- neda_data %>%
  mutate(submission_date = mdy(submission_date)) %>%
  filter(submission_date <= as.Date("2026-10-28"))
```

```{r calculate uptake rate}
neda_filtered %>%
  summarize(
    n_screened_total = n(),
    n_pbn_uptake = sum(submission_id %in% koko_data$submission_id),
    percent_uptake = (n_pbn_uptake / n_screened_total)* 100
  )
```

Note re the age data: People who select 13-17 are asked to type exact age and a handful of responses do not make sense (not 13-17) but still included here because they clicked the age range button.
